title: Transition from the Lineage of the Sikh Gurus to Aurangzeb’s Tyranny

blocks.text: The lineage page advances through the Gurus in order and emphasizes the lamp-to-lamp succession of the Gurus as the proper image for transmission. Each Guru lights the next without rupture, so continuity rather than competition defines the line from Nanak to Gobind Singh.

From that ordered lineage, the narrative pivots toward the age of Mughal oppression and the questions raised by David Murry about conflict with the empire. The shift matters because the serene continuity of succession now meets the violence of Aurangzeb's reign.
This page therefore bridges doctrinal order and political crisis. It closes the succession list and opens the conditions under which martyrdom and resistance will have to be explained.
